content:
Tova Chen: Hey folks! Tova here — starting today on Eng Platform. Super excited. I’m in the SF office Wed–Fri for the next few weeks. Big fan of cardamom bagels, tiny desk plants, and synths. Allergic to walnuts (sad face). Any tips for where to pick up a badge and best lunch spots? :wave:
Maya Patel: welcome!! :tada: Badge is at reception — bring an ID and they’ll print one. Lunch meet by the kitchen at 12:30 if you wanna join.
Devon: hi Tova — welcome! If you want a plant buddy I can bring a small succulent to your desk :seedling:
Jiro Tanaka: FYI we usually have free bagels in the kitchen on Friday mornings (shoutout @people-ops). Also there’s a quick boardgame group after lunch on Fridays — 30 mins, casual.
OpsBot: Security reminder — please complete the building access form: https://redwood.example.com/access-form (required for badge activation).
Ava: welcome Tova! I’ll grab you a cardamom bagel on Friday if they show up, promise :bagel:
Liam: Welcome! If you like plants, the window ledge near row 4B gets sun and we keep a community watering schedule.
Tova Chen: Awesome, thank you all!! Quick Q — I’m vegan, any reliable lunch options nearby?
Maya Patel: plenty — the office ordering usually has a vegan option and ‘Mint & Rye’ on 3rd has great bowls.
Devon: also adding you to the #plant-adoptions thread — we keep a list of who’s looking after what, makes weekend care easier.
Jiro Tanaka: if you’re into synths, we have a tiny synth club that meets Wed evenings at 6. Bring headphones and curiosity :synth:
Ava: if you need a desk lamp or extra monitor cable, DM me — I usually hoard spare cables 😅
Tova Chen: This is amazing, thanks y’all. I’ll swing by reception now and see you at 12:30 — excited to meet the synth club too.
Maya Patel: see you at lunch! :wave:
Devon: welcome again — can’t wait to hear your favorite synth patches.
Jiro Tanaka: welcome to Redwood, Tova!
